responsibility: Documents the vendored rustc-hash crate used by upstream Rust borrow-checking dependencies. It explains the fast non-cryptographic FxHasher/FxHashMap design derived from rustc and Firefox use, its intended compiler-oriented performance tradeoffs versus SipHash or FNV, and its no_std configuration, serving as dependency reference documentation rather than implementing hashing logic in gccrs itself.
same_name_distinction: This README.md is the one under vendor/rustc-hash/ and is distinguished within the README group by documenting the fast FxHasher/FxHashMap compiler-oriented hashing crate, not the datafrog engine, log facade, or polonius-engine library.
